source_observations.note: Published 20 Nov, covers 10–16 Nov. Its healthcare, market, flooding, winterization, aid, and medical-evacuation details are retrospective; selected material changes already recorded in earlier watches; no confirmed new within-window change.

Reviewed latest-news index; Gaza Bureij, Deir al-Balah and Maghazi casualties listed were previously recorded. Later same-day headlines largely concerned the West Bank, diplomacy or advocacy, and were excluded.

Updated Friday account lists seven killed and at least thirteen wounded, including four at Bureij and two near Deir al-Balah; corroborates existing reports but does not establish additional distinct casualties.

Six-death aggregate broken down as four Bureij, one Deir al-Balah and one Nuseirat; differs from seven in Al Jazeera/Anadolu. No additive deaths inferred; reported hospital confirmations of bodies in Bureij and Deir/Nuseirat. Article's clock time is not mapped conclusively to observation window.
Two reported Deir al-Balah fatalities and Shuja'iyya/east Khan Younis demolition operations were already logged in the latest verified predecessor.

excluded_candidates: Bureij strike revised four-death count: predecessor already recorded same-incident update, not an additional attack.
Deir al-Balah death count one versus two: predecessor already logged reconciliation issue; second established-source account corroborates but does not resolve count or prove a new incident.

Nuseirat death, Nuseirat displaced-tent injuries, Maghazi injuries/families fleeing, Sabra injuries and Shuja'iyya/Khan Younis demolitions: recorded in earlier run ledger; no independently verified new impact.
AFP six and Al Jazeera/Anadolu seven are overlapping daily aggregates with unresolved discrepancy, not separate fatalities.
OCHA 20 November publication contains 10–16 November retrospective data; no independently verified fresh post-predecessor development.
Opinion, unsupported social claims, World Bank/UNICEF advocacy announcements lacking operational change, West Bank-only incidents, and 2023/2025 date-collision results excluded.
